title: CVM 处理（CVM List 4203/1F03 + Fail CVM，CVMRLEF=1）
summary: CVM List 为 24 字节（X/Y 金额 + 8 条 CV Rule：4203、1F03、6×0000），交易金额 55.00 使终端判定「Reader CVM Limit Reached or Exceeded」（CVMRLEF=1，PROFILE_02 的 CVM 限额为 0）；终端在 CVMRLEF=1 时不处理 No CVM required 规则，且其 Enhanced Contactless Reader Capabilities（9F6E[1]&0x40=0）不支持联机 PIN，故 4203 被跳过、1F03 被跳过、落到 0000（Fail CVM processing，condition=Always）→ 无任何 CVM 被实际执行、验证失败，正确的 CVM Results（9F34）应为 3F 00 01（EMV 4.4 Book 4 Annex A4 表 33；档案随案例内嵌）。

operator_instructions.notes: tap the phone on the POS reader when it shows 55.00 EUR

preconditions: phone NFC enabled and card simulator app in foreground

POS terminal configured with CONF_01 + PROFILE_02: PROFILE_02's term (9F33=200888, 9F6E=9C800003, DF810A=00000000) is the only module that reproduces the log's 9F33=200888 and 9F6E=9C804003 (the kernel ORs 0x40 into 9F6E byte 3 when CVMRLEF=1)
amount 55.00 with PROFILE_02's CVM limit of 0 makes the terminal take the 'Reader CVM Limit Reached or Exceeded' path (CVMRLEF=1, log line 'g_emv_cnxt->CVMRLEF = 1')

the card's 9F6E/9F33 do not support Enciphered PIN online (9F6E[1] & 0x40 = 0), so CV Rule 4203 (condition 03) is skipped; with CVMRLEF=1 the kernel also skips No CVM required rules (1F03); the first applicable rule is 0000 (Fail CVM processing, condition Always)

expected CVM Results: 3F 00 01 - EMV 4.4 Book 4 Annex A4 Table 33 sets byte 1 to the CVM Code actually performed ('3F' if none), byte 2 to its condition ('00' if none) and byte 3 to '1' when no CVM could be performed; the reference log's 00 00 01 is the V4.2.0 defect fixed in V4.2.3 (emv_cardholder_verification.c:745-756 and 792-799 write 3F 00 01)
the log carries no FCI/GPO, so PDOL/AFL/AIP follow the sibling CVM-PROC83-XP2 case and the log's TVR byte 1 = 0x80 (no ODA) plus its TRM/CVM stages

test_plan.action: host pushes the card profile (CVM List 4203/1F03/0000..., AIP 1880) with CONF_01 + PROFILE_02 and starts emulation

test_plan.expect: POS reads the record, processes the CVM list with CVMRLEF=1 and sends GENERATE AC

test_plan.action: host judges the CVM Results the terminal put in the GENERATE AC CDOL1 data
host judges the CVM Results reported back in the POS OUT DataRecord
